description: Navigate the active or specified tab to a new URL (waits for page load completion by default).

password.description: Optional HTTP Basic Auth password (automatically URL-encoded into the destination URL)

sleepMs.description: Alias for waitMs: milliseconds to sleep after navigation

username.description: Optional HTTP Basic Auth username (automatically URL-encoded into the destination URL)

waitForSelector.description: Optional CSS selector or @ref to wait for after navigation

waitForText.description: Optional text to wait for on the page after navigation

waitMs.description: Optional milliseconds to wait/sleep after navigation

waitUntil.description: Wait for tab load completion before returning (default: true)
